interpretation: Finite computational analogues for structural-modality problems. An analogue is a restricted finite statement with a named certificate shape; it is not a proof of the open conjecture and does not change Solved. Engines listed here are aspirational until a lab probe exists.

entries.analogue: Finite presentation plus explicit a,b in F_2[G] with ab=1 and ba≠1, checked by two independent group-ring multiplications.
entries.certificate: Presentation, support lists for a and b, two multiplication traces.

entries.analogue: After M044 witness replay, audit Elek–Szabó implication for the claimed coefficient field on that presentation.
entries.certificate: Implication checklist with exact field and soficity hypotheses.

entries.analogue: Hitting set for the locked GF(2), degree≤3, ≤20-gate class in research/M088_LOCK.md.
entries.certificate: Gate-list circuits, hitting assignments, independent re-evaluation.

entries.analogue: Finite-dimensional Lie-algebra actions on a named manifold chart with exact polynomial vector fields.
entries.certificate: Polynomial charts and a kernel-checked freeness obstruction or fixed-point certificate.

entries.analogue: Linearized Teukolsky/Regge–Wheeler mode bounds on a fixed Kerr parameter with interval arithmetic.
entries.certificate: Interval enclosures for a finite mode set; not nonlinear stability.

entries.analogue: Diophantine decidability for a named fragment (for example quadratic forms over Q with bounded signature) with exact certificate search.
entries.certificate: Decision procedure trace or explicit undecidability reduction artifact.

entries.certificate: Game-length bound and explicit spoiler/duplicator strategy encoding.
